title: ARIFA overview
content_en: Africa Research Institute For AI (ARIFA) is a pan-African think tank focused on impactful research, training and advisory. It is based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, and works on AI and emerging technologies in African contexts.
content_sw: Africa Research Institute For AI (ARIFA) ni think tank ya Afrika inayojikita katika utafiti wenye matokeo, mafunzo na ushauri. Iko Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, na inafanya kazi kwenye AI na teknolojia zinazoibuka katika mazingira ya Afrika.

title: Mission and vision
content_en: ARIFA's mission is to empower Africa through AI research, capacity building and policy guidance for ethical, sustainable development. Its vision is to be a world-class think tank and global leader in AI research, driving sustainable development and innovation.
content_sw: Dhamira ya ARIFA ni kuiwezesha Afrika kupitia utafiti wa AI, kujenga uwezo na mwongozo wa sera kwa maendeleo yenye maadili na endelevu. Dira yake ni kuwa think tank ya kiwango cha dunia na kiongozi wa kimataifa katika utafiti wa AI, ikiendesha maendeleo endelevu na ubunifu.

title: ARIFA values
content_en: ARIFA lists Innovation & Excellence, Ethical AI & Responsibility, Inclusivity & Diversity, Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing, and Empowerment & Impact-Driven Research among its values.
content_sw: ARIFA inaainisha Ubunifu na Ubora, AI yenye Maadili na Uwajibikaji, Ujumuishi na Tofauti, Ushirikiano na Kushirikiana Maarifa, pamoja na Uwezeshaji na Utafiti wenye Matokeo kama maadili yake.

title: Research focus areas
content_en: ARIFA's research focus areas include Artificial Intelligence; Data Science & Analytics; Digital Transformation & Smart Governance; and AI for Sustainable Development. Examples include deep learning, NLP, computer vision, big-data analysis, predictive modelling, digital government, smart cities, GovTech, digital public infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital identity, agriculture, healthcare, education, climate change, environment, disaster management and energy.
content_sw: Maeneo ya utafiti ya ARIFA ni Artificial Intelligence; Data Science & Analytics; Digital Transformation & Smart Governance; na AI for Sustainable Development. Mifano ni deep learning, NLP, computer vision, uchambuzi wa big data, predictive modelling, digital government, smart cities, GovTech, digital public infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital identity, kilimo, afya, elimu, mabadiliko ya tabianchi, mazingira, majanga na nishati.

title: Certified Data Science Associate (CDSA)
content_en: The Certified Data Science Associate (CDSA) is a practical, career-focused program covering statistics, data exploration, modelling and communicating insights. The detailed page describes a 2–4 month flexible program with guided labs and a capstone. Modules include Python/Jupyter/pandas/NumPy, statistics and exploration, visualization, predictive modelling, and capstone/career preparation.
content_sw: Certified Data Science Associate (CDSA) ni programu ya vitendo inayolenga taaluma, ikifundisha statistics, data exploration, modelling na namna ya kuwasilisha insights. Ukurasa wa kina unaeleza programu ya miezi 2–4 yenye flexibility, guided labs na capstone. Modules ni Python/Jupyter/pandas/NumPy, statistics na exploration, visualization, predictive modelling, na capstone pamoja na career preparation.

title: Certified Natural Language Processing Professional (CNLPP)
content_en: The Certified Natural Language Processing Professional (CNLPP) is an advanced program for language technologies and AI-driven text and speech systems. It covers classical NLP, transformers, language models, RAG, chatbot development, translation, multilingual AI, African languages and responsible NLP. Duration is listed as 3–4 months, flexible and project-based.
content_sw: Certified Natural Language Processing Professional (CNLPP) ni programu ya kiwango cha juu kwa language technologies na mifumo ya AI ya text na speech. Inahusisha classical NLP, transformers, language models, RAG, chatbot development, translation, multilingual AI, lugha za Afrika na responsible NLP. Muda umeorodheshwa kuwa miezi 3–4, kwa mfumo flexible na project-based.

title: Machine Learning programs
content_en: ARIFA lists Certified Machine Learning Associate (CMLA), Certified Machine Learning Engineer (CMLE), and Certified Machine Learning Scientist (CMLS). CMLA is hands-on and project-based, focusing on core ML, model building, feature engineering and evaluation. CMLE focuses on production ML systems, software engineering, DevOps and cloud computing. CMLS focuses on ML theory, algorithmic design, probabilistic modelling and research methodology.
content_sw: ARIFA inaorodhesha Certified Machine Learning Associate (CMLA), Certified Machine Learning Engineer (CMLE), na Certified Machine Learning Scientist (CMLS). CMLA ni ya vitendo na project-based, ikilenga misingi ya ML, kujenga models, feature engineering na evaluation. CMLE inalenga mifumo ya ML ya production, software engineering, DevOps na cloud computing. CMLS inalenga theory ya ML, algorithmic design, probabilistic modelling na research methodology.

title: Artificial Intelligence professional programs
content_en: ARIFA lists Certified Artificial Intelligence Consultant (CAIC), Certified Artificial Intelligence Professional (CAIP), and Certified Artificial Intelligence Engineer (CAIE). CAIC focuses on AI transformation, maturity assessment, strategy, risk management and ethical alignment. CAIP focuses on AI development, deployment, strategy and scalable ethical AI systems. CAIE focuses on engineering practices, deep learning architectures, AI pipelines and deployment at scale.
content_sw: ARIFA inaorodhesha Certified Artificial Intelligence Consultant (CAIC), Certified Artificial Intelligence Professional (CAIP), na Certified Artificial Intelligence Engineer (CAIE). CAIC inalenga AI transformation, kutathmini AI maturity, strategy, risk management na ethical alignment. CAIP inalenga AI development, deployment, strategy na scalable ethical AI systems. CAIE inalenga software engineering practices, deep learning architectures, AI pipelines na deployment at scale.

title: Deep Learning Professional (CDLP)
content_en: The Certified Deep Learning Professional (CDLP) is an advanced technical certification for designing, optimizing and deploying deep neural networks. It covers deep learning theory and practice across vision, language, time series and generative AI.
content_sw: Certified Deep Learning Professional (CDLP) ni certification ya kiwango cha juu kwa kubuni, kuboresha na ku-deploy deep neural networks. Inahusisha theory na practice ya deep learning kwenye vision, language, time series na generative AI.

title: AI for Digital Public Infrastructure and Inclusive Finance
content_en: ARIFA's May 2026–April 2027 finance project aims to use AI to strengthen digital public infrastructure for inclusive, secure, resilient and sustainable financial systems in Tanzania. Focus areas include trust, fraud prevention, interoperability, governance, digital inclusion, AI-enabled fraud detection, risk assessment and responsible AI adoption.

Maeneo ya msingi ni trust, fraud prevention, interoperability, governance, digital inclusion, AI-enabled fraud detection, risk assessment na responsible AI adoption.

title: AI-Driven Mineral Intelligence and Sustainable Mining
content_en: ARIFA's June 2025–June 2027 mining project applies machine learning, remote sensing, predictive analytics and computer vision to mining challenges. Its five pillars are intelligent mineral prospecting, real-time environmental monitoring, AI-assisted mine safety, operational optimization and digital supply-chain traceability.

Nguzo zake tano ni intelligent mineral prospecting, real-time environmental monitoring, AI-assisted mine safety, operational optimization na digital supply-chain traceability.

title: Certified Artificial Intelligence Associate (CAIA)
content_en: CAIA is an intermediate-level certification for designing, implementing and managing AI solutions. Duration: 8-16 weeks depending on pace and format; delivery is online or hybrid. Modules: (1) Advanced ML and model optimization, (2) Computer vision, (3) Advanced NLP and transformers, (4) AI deployment and MLOps, (5) AI governance, safety and responsible innovation. Tools include TensorFlow, PyTorch and Hugging Face. Assessment: 2 major projects plus a capstone, quizzes and labs per module, and an online proctored final exam. Target audience: AI foundation graduates, junior data scientists/ML engineers, developers moving into AI, and technical product managers.
content_sw: CAIA ni cheti cha kiwango cha kati cha kubuni, kutekeleza na kusimamia suluhisho za AI. Muda: wiki 8-16 kulingana na kasi na mfumo; mafunzo ni mtandaoni au hybrid. Moduli: (1) Advanced ML na uboreshaji wa modeli, (2) Computer vision, (3) Advanced NLP na transformers, (4) Usambazaji wa AI na MLOps, (5) Utawala, usalama na ubunifu wenye uwajibikaji wa AI. Zana ni pamoja na TensorFlow, PyTorch na Hugging Face. Tathmini: miradi 2 mikubwa pamoja na capstone, majaribio na maabara kwa kila moduli, na mtihani wa mwisho mtandaoni unaosimamiwa. Walengwa: wahitimu wa AI Foundation, wanasayansi wa data wa ngazi ya chini/ML engineers, watengenezaji programu wanaohamia AI, na technical product managers.

title: Data Science certifications: CDSP, CDSC and CDA
content_en: CDSP (Certified Data Science Professional, syllabus 6) is advanced, for experienced practitioners: statistical modelling, machine learning, data engineering and business analytics. CDSC (Certified Data Science Consultant, syllabus 7) is leadership-level: data strategy, stakeholder engagement, governance and compliance for private, public and development sectors. CDA (Certified Data Analyst, syllabus 8) is entry-to-mid level: collecting, cleaning, analyzing, visualizing and communicating data. The entry data-science certification is CDSA (syllabus 5).
content_sw: CDSP (Certified Data Science Professional, syllabus 6) ni cha kiwango cha juu kwa wataalamu wenye uzoefu: statistical modelling, machine learning, data engineering na business analytics. CDSC (Certified Data Science Consultant, syllabus 7) ni cha ngazi ya uongozi: mkakati wa data, ushirikishwaji wa wadau, utawala na uzingatiaji wa sheria kwa sekta binafsi, umma na maendeleo. CDA (Certified Data Analyst, syllabus 8) ni cha ngazi ya kuanzia hadi kati: kukusanya, kusafisha, kuchambua, kuonyesha kwa picha na kuwasilisha data. Cheti cha kuanzia cha data science ni CDSA (syllabus 5).

title: IJAIT journal overview
content_en: The International Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Technology (IJAIT) is an open-access, peer-reviewed journal published by ARIFA, two issues a year, CC BY 4.0. It publishes regular papers, research notes, field reviews, position papers, book reviews and competition summaries across IT and AI, including machine learning, IoT, cloud, cyber security, data science, blockchain, health informatics and robotics. Editor in Chief: Zaipuna O. Yonah. Peer review is double-blind and originality is checked with iThenticate.
content_sw: International Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Technology (IJAIT) ni jarida huria (open access) lenye mapitio ya wataalamu linalochapishwa na ARIFA, matoleo mawili kwa mwaka, CC BY 4.0. Linachapisha makala za kawaida, research notes, field reviews, position papers, book reviews na muhtasari wa mashindano katika IT na AI, ikiwemo machine learning, IoT, cloud, usalama wa mtandao, data science, blockchain, health informatics na roboti. Mhariri Mkuu: Zaipuna O. Yonah. Mapitio ni double-blind na uhalisi hukaguliwa kwa iThenticate.
review_flag: Site says first issue 'expected Sept 2024'; E-ISSN equals P-ISSN; submission link points to journal.uir.ac.id. Verify with ARIFA.

title: IJAIT submission rules and pricing
content_en: IJAIT manuscripts: English, 4-16 pages, IEEE citation style, title max 10 words with no acronyms, abstract max 200 words, at least 20 references (80% journal articles, 80% from the last 5 years). Structure: Introduction, Method, Results & Discussion, Conclusion. Reading is free. Optional subscriptions (USD): institutional online 167, print 174, online+print 244, single issue 94; individual online 46, print 48, online+print 66, single issue 32; add $13 shipping outside the US.
content_sw: Makala za IJAIT: Kiingereza, kurasa 4-16, mtindo wa marejeo wa IEEE, kichwa maneno yasiyozidi 10 bila vifupisho, muhtasari usiozidi maneno 200, marejeo yasiyopungua 20 (80% ya majarida, 80% ya miaka 5 iliyopita). Muundo: Utangulizi, Mbinu, Matokeo na Mjadala, Hitimisho. Kusoma ni bure. Usajili wa hiari (USD): taasisi mtandaoni 167, chapa 174, mtandaoni+chapa 244, toleo moja 94; mtu binafsi mtandaoni 46, chapa 48, mtandaoni+chapa 66, toleo moja 32; ongeza $13 usafirishaji nje ya Marekani.

Ajira: kitufe cha Apply kwenye nafasi husika. Chatbot haiwezi kusajili wala kupokea malipo yenyewe na haipaswi kukusanya taarifa za malipo kwenye mazungumzo.

title: Out-of-scope questions
content_en: The chatbot answers only about ARIFA: its organization, research, training, events, publications, careers, partnerships and contacts. For unrelated requests (general knowledge, coding help, news, other organizations, personal advice), politely say it can only help with ARIFA topics and offer relevant ARIFA topics. General AI questions may be answered only briefly when tied to an ARIFA program (for example what a certification covers). Never speculate about ARIFA facts that are not in the knowledge base.
content_sw: Chatbot inajibu maswali kuhusu ARIFA tu: taasisi, utafiti, mafunzo, matukio, machapisho, ajira, ushirikiano na mawasiliano. Kwa maombi yasiyohusiana (maarifa ya jumla, msaada wa programu, habari, mashirika mengine, ushauri binafsi), sema kwa upole kwamba inasaidia mada za ARIFA tu na pendekeza mada za ARIFA zinazoweza kusaidia. Maswali ya jumla ya AI yajibiwe kwa ufupi tu yakihusishwa na programu ya ARIFA (mfano cheti kinahusu nini). Usibashiri ukweli kuhusu ARIFA usio kwenye knowledge base.

title: Privacy and sensitive data
content_en: Do not ask for or store passwords, payment card details, mobile-money PINs or national ID numbers in chat. For applications, payments and personal enquiries, send users to the official ARIFA forms or info@arifa.org. Only share staff information that is public on the ARIFA website; do not share personal phone numbers or emails of individual staff.
content_sw: Usiombe wala kuhifadhi nywila, taarifa za kadi za malipo, PIN za pesa za simu au namba za vitambulisho kwenye mazungumzo. Kwa maombi, malipo na maswali binafsi, elekeza watumiaji kwenye fomu rasmi za ARIFA au info@arifa.org. Toa taarifa za wafanyakazi zilizo wazi kwenye tovuti ya ARIFA tu; usitoe simu au barua pepe binafsi za wafanyakazi.

title: Chatbot persona and greeting
content_en: The assistant is 'ARIFA Assistant', an official information assistant for the Africa Research Institute For AI. Tone: professional, warm, concise. It greets in the user's language, answers in 2-6 sentences unless asked for detail, and ends factual answers with the relevant ARIFA link. Kiswahili replies should use clear standard Kiswahili and keep technical terms (AI, machine learning, MLOps) in English.
content_sw: Msaidizi anaitwa 'ARIFA Assistant', msaidizi rasmi wa taarifa wa Africa Research Institute For AI. Sauti: ya kitaalamu, ya kirafiki, fupi. Anasalimu kwa lugha ya mtumiaji, anajibu kwa sentensi 2-6 isipokuwa ombi la maelezo zaidi, na anamalizia majibu ya kiukweli kwa kiungo husika cha ARIFA. Majibu ya Kiswahili yatumie Kiswahili sanifu na kuacha istilahi za kiufundi (AI, machine learning, MLOps) kwa Kiingereza.

title: ARIFA background
content_en: ARIFA describes itself as a pan-African, not-for-profit think tank in advancing impactful research, training and advisory, focused on the African continent and evidence-based policymaking. Its website claims 10+ years of impact and lists headquarters in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Its two pillars on the homepage are research excellence (AI, data science and emerging technologies) and capacity building (certifications and short courses).
content_sw: ARIFA inajieleza kama think tank ya pan-Afrika isiyo ya faida katika kuendeleza utafiti wenye matokeo, mafunzo na ushauri, inayolenga bara la Afrika na uundaji wa sera unaotegemea ushahidi. Tovuti yake inadai miaka 10+ ya matokeo na makao makuu yako Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Nguzo zake mbili kwenye ukurasa wa mwanzo ni ubora wa utafiti (AI, data science na teknolojia zinazoibuka) na kujenga uwezo (vyeti na short courses).
